title: Understanding Residuals
text: Residuals in a regression model are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. Think about how these differences relate to the predictions themselves.

title: Orthogonality in Regression
text: In the context of regression, orthogonality means that two vectors are perpendicular to each other. Consider what it means for the residuals and predictions to be orthogonal.
